description: This line plot, titled "Finetuning for different r, Gazeta," illustrates the performance of four different fine-tuning methods—T5 + LoRA, MBart + LoRA, T5 + AdaLoRA, and MBart + AdaLoRA—as measured by ROUGE-1 score, across varying values of the hyperparameter r on the Gazeta dataset. The x-axis represents log r, plotted on a logarithmic scale ranging from 0 to 8, with tick marks at regular intervals of 2. The y-axis represents ROUGE-1 score, plotted on a linear scale from 0 to 35, with tick marks at intervals of 5. The T5 + LoRA method (red line with circular markers) shows a relatively flat performance, starting at approximately 23.5, rising slightly to about 24.5 around log r = 4, and then stabilizing near 24.5. The MBart + LoRA method (purple line with circular markers) begins at 5, dips to a minimum of about 2.5 at log r = 2, then rises to approximately 22.5 at log r = 4, and remains relatively stable near 23.5 for the remainder of the range. The T5 + AdaLoRA method (green line with circular markers) starts at about 23.5, increases steadily to approximately 30 at log r = 4, and then plateaus near 30. The MBart + AdaLoRA method (orange line with circular markers) begins at 5, rises sharply to about 20 at log r = 2, continues increasing to approximately 32 at log r = 4, and then stabilizes near 33.5 for the rest of the range.
